body:
Hi Avicus Staff and Zeusy,
Zeusy, you said that all of the other accounts have infractions similar to one of mine. I do not know about them, but I appealed from that and got back on, because I do not hack. On the computer I use, hacks have never been downloaded or used... or however you can get them. This is my favorite server, and I would appreciate re-considering. I love this server, and I do not want to be banned for something I have not done. Thanks.
-xSuper_J_MCx
